name: Tamaki Sakura
source:
[b]An Overly Friendly Bunny Girl[/b]
A beautiful girl who transfers into school at the latest possible timing: winter of her third year. Hatsuyuki's rough exterior doesn't dissuade her from talking to him at every opportunity she gets.
She's innocent, naive, and kind of odd. It would seem she's never had a proper school life, as everything from the classes to making friends comes across as new and exciting for her. Though it's already that hectic period just before graduation, she's enjoying her time to the fullest.
She's always accompanied by a rabbit called Nemu. Apparently she came to this town looking for something...
